# First, filter the dataframe for the two object types mentioned
irregular_df = df[df['object type'] == 'irregular galaxy']
spiral_df = df[df['object type'] == 'spiral galaxy']

# Calculate the mean apparent magnitude for each object type
mean_irregular = irregular_df['apparent magnitude'].mean()
mean_spiral = spiral_df['apparent magnitude'].mean()

# Check if the mean of irregular galaxies is exactly 2.1 greater than the mean of spiral galaxies
# Using a small tolerance for floating point comparison
tolerance = 1e-9
answer = abs(mean_irregular - mean_spiral - 2.1) < tolerance
